question: Given AnyRouter's conflicting official documentation, should CodexBar standardize this provider on a scoped `ak_…` management key now, or retain inference-key setup only after live production proof demonstrates that `/api/v1/credits` supports it?
rationale: Choosing the wrong public credential contract would either ship a provider that fails authentication or unnecessarily ask users for a more privileged secret.

options.title: Require scoped management keys
options.body: Request an `ak_…` key with only `read:credits`, revise setup and errors, and prove the live flow before merge.

options.title: Prove dual credential support
options.body: Retain generic bearer-token acceptance but add redacted evidence and tests showing both credential types work, with clear least-privilege guidance.

options.title: Pause the provider
options.body: Hold both AnyRouter PRs until the upstream authentication contract is stable and consistently documented.

recommendation.title: Require scoped management keys
recommendation.body: Request an `ak_…` key with only `read:credits`, revise setup and errors, and prove the live flow before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and provider architecture owner, this account is the best available owner for the credential and landing-branch decision.
